purpose: The naming vocabulary for M82, fixed and hashed before any atom is named. Plan Section 9 and Amendment R6 require a vocabulary registered in advance; R9 additionally requires a gating positive control, which the in-corpus/absent split below supplies.

label_source.description: DomainNet ships 345 class names in the HuggingFace parquet schema metadata. The v13 corpus uses labels 0-127, so 128 names are present in the corpus and 217 are absent from it. Both the in-corpus names and the absent ones are taken verbatim from the dataset rather than authored here, so the vocabulary cannot be tuned toward a flattering result.

distractor_rationale: The 217 DomainNet classes absent from the v13 corpus are the naming instrument's far-field control, in the role N1 gave far-field noise for the detection instrument. They are drawn from the same concept distribution as the in-corpus names, are the same kind of word, and are the same length on average, but nothing in the corpus depicts them. A naming channel that assigns absent names at the rate it assigns present ones is not reading the atoms. This rate is reported as false_naming_rate.

style_terms.rationale: The v13 corpus is 61 percent quickdraw, a recorded corpus defect. An atom may therefore encode rendering style rather than object identity, and a vocabulary of object nouns alone could not name such an atom - it would be forced to emit an object word for a style direction and would look wrong when it was in fact reading something real. The six DomainNet domains are registered as a second vocabulary section so that style-carrying atoms are nameable and countable. The fraction of atoms best named by a style term is reported, never hidden.

terms.name: quickdraw
terms.phrase: a rough black and white doodle

object_templates.rationale: CLIP zero-shot practice averages a fixed ensemble of prompts rather than trusting a single phrasing. The ensemble spans the corpus's six rendering styles so that no single domain's phrasing is privileged; a photo-only template would systematically favour the 3,607 real images over the 44,800 quickdraw ones. The ensemble is fixed here, before any naming, and may not be extended after a naming number is seen.
templates: a piece of clipart of a {}.

name_normalisation: DomainNet class names use underscores. Underscores are replaced by single spaces before templating, and no other edit is made.
